entry_points.summary: Collect commands, agents, and skills from repo root
Require Supported, Unsupported, and Notes sections
Compute target-specific conventional output paths
Replace unsupported call sites for Cursor exports
Render one source entry as a Cursor .mdc rule
Emit and validate Cursor .mdc rules
Replace unsupported call sites for Codex exports
Render command and skill prompt files
Consolidate all agents into AGENTS.md
Emit Codex prompts and AGENTS.md
Replace unsupported call sites for agy exports
Render commands as agy workflows
Render agents as agy rules
Render skills as native agy skills
Render flat agy prompts for commands, agents, skills
Generate agy-plugin.yaml manifest
Emit and validate all agy export surfaces
Fail on forbidden tarball entry
Search tarball listing for one forbidden pattern
Run selected export adapters sequentially

invariants: Source of truth remains commands/, agents/, and skills/*/SKILL.md
Unsupported target constructs are replaced with explicit limitation comments
Each adapter validates its emitted files before reporting success
CAPABILITIES.md files must contain Supported, Unsupported, and Notes sections
/z-export runs target adapters sequentially and continues past failures
Tarball audit rejects providers, harness archives/plans, exports, homes, and legacy plans
gotchas: export-common.py does not enforce tarball exclusions; audit-tarball.sh does
Codex consolidates agents into AGENTS.md instead of per-agent prompts
agy emits workflows, rules, skills, flat prompts, manifest, capabilities, and README
Adapters delegate all writes under the selected exports/<target> output root
Regenerated exports include planning-router and z-audit-plan surfaces
